Kuvitus: koepöytä ylhäältä vinosti nähty: Illustration: an exam desk seen obliquely from above. On the desk is a laptop whose screen shows a graph: measured points and a rising straight line fitted to them. Beside the laptop are a calculator, a squared notebook with a body and arrows drawn in pencil, a pencil and a water bottle. There is a clock on the wall. The picture has no text.
Kaavio: täydellisen ratkaisun seitsemän: Diagram: the seven steps of a complete solution as numbered cards one below the other. 1 Given and find: quantities with units. 2 Principle: the law and why it applies. 3 Formula solved: the unknown in symbols. 4 Conversions: to base units. 5 Substitution: numbers with units. 6 Answer: unit and precision. 7 Reasonableness: an estimate or a comparison. Between the cards are arrows from top to bottom.
laki ja miksi se pätee: the law and why it applies
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: kärryn paikka x m: Graph to scale: the position x of a trolley in metres as a function of the time t in seconds, invented example values. Seven measured points at the times 0–6 s rise almost in a straight line. A straight line fitted to the points passes between them. The slope is read from the line at two points far apart, (1.0 s; 1.02 m) and (5.0 s; 3.50 m), with a dashed triangle: Δt = 4.0 s and Δx = 2.48 m, so the slope is about 0.62 m/s.
Kuvaaja: heilahdusjakson neliö T² neliös: Graph: the square of the period T² in square seconds as a function of the length L of the string in metres. Six measured points at the lengths 0.200–0.950 m rise in a straight line. A straight line fitted to the points crosses the vertical axis a little above the origin, at about 0.06 s². Two points read from the line are marked with dashed lines: (0.100 m; 0.46 s²) and (0.900 m; 3.68 s²). The slope is about 4.03 s²/m.
